rules.name: Equilibrium is measured from wick high to wick low, not from candle bodies
rules.setupAnchor: Choose the previous day range or a significant higher-timeframe reference candle, then measure from wick high to wick low
rules.confirmationTrigger: Mark the 0.5 midpoint of the full wick range and treat that midpoint as the equilibrium divider for the active setup
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: Protected structure is evaluated relative to the wick-based midpoint, not a body-based midpoint that hides the real price extremes
rules.invalidationCondition: The midpoint is derived from candle bodies instead of the true wick extremes, or the reference range changes before the setup completes
rules.targetLogic: Use the wick-based midpoint as the divider that determines whether continuation should hold in the correct half or fail toward the opposite side
exceptions: When focusing on equilibrium only, ignore candle bodies even if other tools like CISD or order blocks use body measurements
machineChecks: Compute equilibrium as the midpoint between wick high and wick low
Reject body-only midpoint calculations for this topic
Persist the selected midpoint until the reference range is intentionally replaced

rules.name: In expansion conditions, respect of the correct half of the range defines the directional bias
rules.setupAnchor: After equilibrium is marked, split the range into upper and lower halves and align those halves with the active directional thesis
rules.confirmationTrigger: Bullish continuation requires price to respect the upper half of the range, while bearish continuation requires price to respect the lower half
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: Continuation structure remains healthy only while the correct half keeps acting as support or resistance for the active move
rules.invalidationCondition: Price closes through the wrong side of equilibrium and the expected continuation half no longer holds
rules.targetLogic: Keep the bias in the current direction while the correct half is respected; reassess once the midpoint fails
exceptions: If the market is no longer in expansion conditions, equilibrium can become a neutral divider instead of a continuation filter
machineChecks: Track whether price is holding in the correct half of the reference range
Flag loss of continuation bias when closes move through the wrong side of equilibrium
Keep the continuation bias active only while the expected half remains respected
ambiguityNotes: The first strict tolerance for saying price respected versus barely pierced equilibrium is not yet numeric

rules.name: A continuation day is framed from the previous day's equilibrium and confirmed by lower-timeframe closes that stay on the correct side
rules.setupAnchor: Mark the previous day's wick-high-to-wick-low midpoint before the new session begins
rules.confirmationTrigger: Treat the continuation setup as valid only when lower-timeframe closures do not occur beyond the previous day's equilibrium in the wrong direction
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: The new session can keep building protected structure only while the prior-day equilibrium continues to hold as the continuation divider
rules.invalidationCondition: Lower-timeframe closes print beyond the previous day's equilibrium in the wrong direction or the session reclaims the opposite side of the range
rules.targetLogic: Once equilibrium holds, trade in the direction of the continuation bias through the previous day's high or low and toward external liquidity
exceptions: Respecting equilibrium does not require an exact touch; the failure condition is the wrong-side close, not minor noise around the midpoint
machineChecks: Project the previous day's equilibrium into the new session
Reject continuation when lower-timeframe closes occur beyond equilibrium in the wrong direction
Allow minor probing around the midpoint only until the close-based failure condition appears

rules.name: Equilibrium becomes tradable when the respected half also contains a point of interest and lower-timeframe confirmation
rules.setupAnchor: After identifying the correct half of the range, look for a fair value gap, order block, or protected swing inside that half
rules.confirmationTrigger: Require a reaction at the point of interest plus a candle closure and CISD on the lower timeframe before treating the equilibrium area as actionable
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: Protected highs and lows formed inside the respected half validate that equilibrium is supporting real continuation structure rather than passive balance
rules.invalidationCondition: The equilibrium half contains no usable point of interest, or the lower timeframe never confirms with a closure and CISD
rules.targetLogic: Use the equilibrium half as the directional filter, the point of interest as the entry zone, and the higher-timeframe range objective as the target frame
exceptions: If the first point of interest fails, newly created liquidity inside the same respected half can become the fallback anchor
machineChecks: Require both a point of interest and lower-timeframe confirmation before promoting an equilibrium reaction into an entry setup
Allow fallback to newly created liquidity only if it remains inside the respected half of the range
Mark the setup as context-only when equilibrium is respected but no confirmation appears
ambiguityNotes: The first-pass ranking rule between multiple points of interest inside the respected half still needs a stricter algorithm

openQuestions: What numeric tolerance around the 0.5 line should count as valid equilibrium respect versus a true close-through failure?
How should multiple points of interest inside the respected half be ranked before lower-timeframe confirmation appears?
